instruction: Set up a folder called 'Important Sites' on the bookmarks bar in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a bookmark folder named 'Important Sites' on the bookmarks bar. The evaluator uses a custom metric function that uses subset checking to verify the folder exists, allowing other folders to also be present on the bookmark bar. This is a paraphrased instruction with a different folder name than the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter 'get_bookmarks' extracts Chrome bookmarks structure including bookmark_bar folders
Metric uses subset checking (line 36: 'set(rule['names']).issubset(set(bookmark_bar_folders_names))') which correctly verifies that 'Important Sites' folder exists among bookmark bar folders
Subset logic is semantically correct: instruction says 'set up a new folder named Important Sites' which requires creating that folder, not removing other existing folders
Postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure bookmark state is persisted and can be verified
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if bookmarks structure is malformed (KeyError/TypeError/AttributeError)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement specified in the instruction
